title: Move replaceFile out of board-store into src/main/app/replace-file.ts
notes:
replaceFile is the app's general atomic write but lives in board/board-store.ts. notes-store.ts, worktree-store.ts, session-index-store.ts and chat-sessions.ts import a file helper from the board's store, and its comment ("every file the dashboard keeps about a project") no longer describes what it writes. Cost: anyone looking for how the app writes a file finds it under the board, and a change to it reads as a board change. Move it to src/main/app/replace-file.ts with its .tmp test beside it; writeBoard keeps calling it.

Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/177
Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/175#discussion_r4437993801
